The test image shows a severely dried, curled, dark brown mango leaf. It's completely desiccated and curled upward. No white powdery coating or black sooty layer visible. This strongly suggests Die_Back based on the symptom description ("leaves curl upwards and fall off").

Let me view one reference from each class first.
Die_Back reference: Very similar - a completely dried, dark brown, curled leaf. Strong match. Now let me check the other classes.
Anthracnose reference: Shows a leaf with brown coloration and some lesion damage at the tip, but the leaf retains its shape more and isn't as severely curled. Less similar to test image.
Powdery Mildew: Shows white/powdery spots on a green leaf. Very different from the test image. Not a match.

Sooty Mould: Shows a green leaf with dark black/sooty patches. Very different from the test image. Not a match.

Now I've viewed 1 from each class (4 views used). Die_Back is the clear frontrunner. Let me use remaining 4 views to confirm, checking the second Die_Back reference and second Anthracnose (the only other plausible candidate).
Die_Back ref #2: Another dried, curled, dark brown leaf. Very similar to the test image in terms of the complete desiccation and curling pattern.

Anthracnose ref #2: A green leaf with distinct dark brown/black spots scattered across the surface. Very different from the test image. Anthracnose shows discrete lesions on otherwise green leaves, not complete desiccation.
Die_Back stem reference: Shows a withered, dried twig/stem with attached curled leaf material. Consistent with the die-back pattern of progressive drying.

Sooty Mould ref #2: Dark green leaf with black sooty encrustations on the surface. Still retains green color underneath. Not a match.

All 8 views used. The evidence is clear:

- **Die_Back**: Both leaf references show completely dried, dark brown, curled leaves, nearly identical to the test image.
- **Anthracnose**: Shows discrete brown/black spots on otherwise green leaves. Very different.
- **Powdery_Mildew**: White powdery coating on green leaves. Very different.
- **Sooty_Mould**: Black sooty coating on green leaves. Very different.

The test image's completely desiccated, curled-upward, dark brown leaf matches Die_Back perfectly, both visually and per the symptom description ("leaves curl upwards and fall off, twigs withering").
